authority_note: Repository is authoritative for flag NAMES, defaults, definition sites and effects. Whether a flag is armed in any running environment is HOST-VERIFIED / OUTSIDE REPOSITORY CONTROL. No secret or env-var VALUES appear in this file.

flags.name: BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_ENABLED
flags.effect_when_enabled: The customer broker-account journey backend is live: test-connection / retry-validation / replace-credentials / disconnect endpoints operate; run_broker_validation records durable validation state and folds outcomes into WP3 health + WP2 pause reconcile + WP5.2 projection.
flags.effect_when_disabled: _bc_guard() returns HTTP 404 for the entire WP1A surface; the customer journey does not exist.
flags.deploy_requirement: None to toggle (read live per call). Full operation additionally requires the signing keyring provisioned to the seal-only backend at arming time (ADR-0028), which is a separate Sponsor-gated deploy step.
flags.verification: With flag OFF: WP1A endpoints return 404. With flag ON: endpoints operate and a BrokerAccountValidationAttempt row is written per validation. Tests: backend/trading/tests_broker_connectivity.py.
flags.rollback: Set the flag to a false value (unset / 0). Read live, so disarming is immediate with no schema change; existing rows are simply not read while OFF.

flags.name: BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_EXECUTION_GATE
flags.effect_when_enabled: Execution is refused unless the account is VALIDATED and eligible, enforced at ExecutionJob creation (model save), re-checked at claim (next_job) and re-evaluated FRESH at final dispatch before order_send; fail-closed on any ambiguity; refusals audited (EXECUTION_GATE_REFUSED / EXECUTION_DISPATCH_REFUSED).
flags.effect_when_disabled: The gate is transparent: GateDecision(True, 'gate_disabled') short-circuits before any DB read; existing production execution behaviour is unchanged.
flags.deploy_requirement: None to toggle (read live). Arming is gated on WP6 certification per ADR-0029.
flags.verification: With flag OFF: no execution-path change, no extra DB read at the gate. With flag ON: an ineligible account's exposure-opening job is blocked at creation, failed at claim, and refused at dispatch. Tests: execution/tests_broker_gate.py, tests_dispatch_gate.py, tests_wse.py, tests_execution_entrypoints.py.
flags.rollback: Set the flag (and BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_HEALTH_ENABLED) to a false value. Additive/transparent when OFF; disarming instantly restores prior execution behaviour. No dedicated code-revert procedure exists or is required.

flags.name: BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_HEALTH_ENABLED
flags.effect_when_enabled: The WP3 broker-health state machine is active: it folds validation-attempt evidence + staleness + lifecycle into BrokerAccountHealth, emits audit + deduplicated alerts, and exposes the convergence contract. The health scheduler remains an inert framework (no validator wired). Health-driven pause/dispatch refusal additionally require BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_EXECUTION_GATE.
flags.effect_when_disabled: Every public entry point is a no-op returning None; no health row mutated, no scheduler cycle runs, no signal/notification.
flags.deploy_requirement: None to toggle (read live). Uses the same tolerant parser as the execution gate so the two cannot silently disagree; ADR-0030 requires the two broker-connectivity flags be armed together deliberately.
flags.verification: With flag OFF: get_contract returns None, scheduler run_cycle returns {ran:false,reason:disabled}. With flag ON: the customer validation flow converges health immediately. Tests: reliability/tests_broker_health.py.
flags.rollback: Set the flag to a false value; engine returns to DARK instantly (read live, entry points no-op). Optional schema rollback: migrate reliability 0003 drops BrokerAccountHealth (additive table, safe while OFF).

flags.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_ENABLED
flags.effect_when_enabled: The customer Broker Accounts journey routes render and the nav entry appears.
flags.effect_when_disabled: The broker-accounts routes call notFound() (404) before any data fetch; no nav entry; no API call is ever made; the existing UI is byte-identical.
flags.deploy_requirement: Frontend rebuild with the flag set (Next.js inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* at build). Arming = a rebuild, a separate Sponsor-gated step. Listed in frontend/parity/env-allowlist.json.
flags.verification: With flag OFF: /broker-accounts returns 404, no nav entry. Build a flag-ON image only in a non-production build to verify render. Tests: frontend/src/app/(app)/broker-accounts/flag-gate.test.tsx.
flags.rollback: Redeploy the DARK image built with the flag unset. Cannot be toggled at runtime — it is compiled in.

flags.name: OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED
flags.effect_when_enabled: The operational-event read model records/projects events (projection-only, fail-open, on_commit) and GET /api/operations/account-events/ serves them (owner-scoped).
flags.effect_when_disabled: record_event returns None, all projections early-return, mark_resolved returns 0, and the API returns 404. Every projection call site is additionally fail-open so it can never break the authoritative path.
flags.deploy_requirement: None to toggle (read live). Independent of the broker-connectivity flags. The operator UI additionally requires the separate frontend flag NEXT_PUBLIC_OPERATIONS_ENABLED.
flags.verification: With flag OFF: API returns 404, no rows written. With flag ON: events project on commit and the API returns {summary, timeline}. Check logger 'guvfx.operational_events' for recorder failures. Tests: operational_events tests (WP5.1/5.2).
flags.rollback: Set the flag to a false value; recording and API return to DARK immediately. The read model is a rebuildable projection (a cache) and can be truncated/rebuilt without affecting authoritative state.

flags.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_OPERATIONS_ENABLED
flags.effect_when_enabled: The internal Operations & Support viewer routes render and an admin-only nav entry appears. Data only appears when the backend OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED is also ON; the surface is additionally operator-gated (useAdminRole) and read-only.
flags.effect_when_disabled: The operations routes call notFound() (404) before any hook/API call; no nav entry; no API call; the existing UI is byte-identical.
flags.deploy_requirement: Frontend rebuild with the flag set (build-time inline). Separate from OPERATIONS_EVENTS_ENABLED; both must be armed for the viewer to show data. Listed in frontend/parity/env-allowlist.json.
flags.verification: With flag OFF: /operations/accounts returns 404, no nav entry, zero API calls (proven by flag-gate.test.tsx). Verify a flag-ON build only in a non-production build.
flags.rollback: Redeploy the DARK image built with the flag unset. Compile-time — cannot be toggled at runtime.

related_tuning_toggles.note: Not arming gates. Behaviour tuning for the health engine; read live; carry no secret. Inert while BROKER_CONNECTIVITY_HEALTH_ENABLED is OFF. Documented for completeness so operators do not confuse them with arming flags.

adjacent_flags_not_in_scope.note: Present in the repo and broker-adjacent, but NOT part of the broker-connectivity / operational-event / execution-gate / health arming domain. Listed so operators do not conflate them. Values here are repo DEFAULTS only.

flags.EXECUTION_HEALTH_ENABLED: default ON (execution/execution_health.py) — existing execution-health sweep, unrelated to broker connectivity
